hero.intro: I build responsive, intuitive and production-ready interfaces with React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. I focus on scalable component architecture, and I'm at home in the design process — from Figma to production.

about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a front-end developer based in Tehran. I care most about component architecture that stays easy to change as a product grows, and about interfaces that feel obvious to the people using them.
about.p2: At Pardazeshgaran Sepehr I started with a three-month React and Redux internship and moved on to full-time production work: internal and client-facing applications built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Ant Design, with a seat in the UI/UX process in Figma.
about.p3: Before that, I spent two years teaching robotics and programming in group and one-on-one classes. I also hold an M.Sc. in Software Engineering — my thesis designed and formally verified a multi-agent architecture for smart schools.

thesis.label: M.Sc. thesis
thesis.title: Designing a Pervasive Agent-Based System for the Smart School Environment
thesis.summary: A multi-agent, edge-oriented architecture for a smart school — documented with the 4+1 view model, evaluated with ATAM and formally verified through CSP model checking in PAT.
